integration.playback: PlaybackService plans the transition with its own request epoch and only accepts attempt-scoped release evidence
integration.output_session: PREFLIGHT -> VALIDATE -> RELEASE -> RECONCILE -> PREPARE -> READY owner transaction with frozen predecessor identities
integration.receipt_validation: confirmed/RELEASED/SUPERVISED_HOST plus exact plan/execution/device/binding/host identity, attempt id and target family
integration.host_release: DoP and DSD->PCM host receipts are native; Native DSD abort and Managed stop publish supervised receipts from the identity the host validated

T01.reason: committed Direct execution releases with the exact plan/execution identity returned by the hosted discard; the receipt is SUPERVISED_HOST only when the host confirms the command

T02.evidence: real PlaybackService -> OutputSessionService -> GStreamerHostedAudioPort -> GStreamerHostSupervisor; exact release evidence; START confirmed by notify_dop_playing

T03.reason: transaction and receipt proof with a controlled host receipt; no physical DAC execution

T04.reason: transaction proof; Managed destination requires a real DAC qualification

T05.reason: transaction proof with Native abort receipt; physical Native DSD requires hardware

T06.reason: transaction proof; physical Native DSD requires hardware

T07.evidence: real supervised host; exact DoP release evidence; DSD->PCM start confirmed by notify_dsd_pcm_playing

T09.reason: real hosted DSD->PCM run: the processing authority reports EFFECTIVE and the conversion evidence observes DSP_NODE; fakesink laboratory sink, not physical DAC

T10.reason: live DSD->PCM run: disable_processing_async proves the bypass, the authority reports BYPASSED and the child identity no longer exposes a processing graph; fakesink laboratory sink

T11.reason: same-family reconfiguration is a destructive handover: exact-identity RELEASE before the host accepts the new quality/rate prepare

T12.reason: same-family DAC change releases device A with its exact binding before binding device B (controlled-host DoP proof), and a physical Direct compatible A<->B switch was executed on SMSL and KINMAX with real alsasink: plan and locator changed and the transition was reacquire. Direct->Direct uses the synchronous reacquire path and publishes no identity-bound release receipt; audibility stays operator-confirmed.

signal_path.installed: PASS_MODELED — SignalPathNode.installed projects the processing commit receipt as a separate stage; a refused install never rewrites EFFECTIVE (tests/audio_phase2/test_signal_path_service.py::test_installed_stage_is_distinct_from_requested_and_effective)
signal_path.handover_truth: PASS — predecessor RELEASED and target RUNNING events asserted in both E2E tests

limitations: The physical evidence covers Direct compatible A<->B on two real USB DACs (alsasink) and shared/strict/compatible field-suite cycles; Native DSD and DoP destinations remain laboratory/host proofs.
Native DSD and Managed destinations require real hardware evidence for physical qualification.
T09/T10 prove DSP install/bypass on the live DSD->PCM runtime backed by the laboratory fakesink, not on a physical DAC.
T11 and the T12 DoP receipt proof use controlled host fakes; the physical T12 scope is a Direct compatible A<->B switch on real ALSA, with no identity-bound release receipt on that synchronous path.
